facts.claim: Instant discount on the installer's invoice, up to $900 (Tier 1 under 2.5 tons, at least 15.2 SEER2, 9.4 EER2, 8.1 HSPF2), up to $1,400 (Tier 1 at 2.5 tons or more), up to $1,500 (Tier 2 under 2.5 tons, at least 17 SEER2, 9.4 EER2, 8.5 HSPF2), up to $2,000 (Tier 2 at 2.5 tons or more). Tons are heating capacity in Btu per hour divided by 12,000.
facts.eligibility: ComEd residential customers; installed by a ComEd heat pump-trained contractor; self-install does not qualify; no application
facts.dates: No end date on the page; program details subject to change or cancellation due to funding limits
facts.notes: Read 2026-10-06 from the expanded 'Air Source & Centrally Ducted Heat Pumps' panel on comed.com (the panel text sits in the page's shadow DOM, so plain text readers miss it). R-410A refrigerant systems are not eligible until the EPA sell-through rule takes effect July 27, 2026, after which the page says they become eligible. The 2025 customer guide PDF said 'up to $2,000' for air source and $1,000 for mini-splits, which matches.

facts.claim: Instant discount up to $500 under 1.5 tons and up to $1,000 at 1.5 tons or more; needs at least 17 SEER2, 9.4 EER2 and 9.0 HSPF2.

facts.claim: Illinois Shines pays for the solar renewable energy credits (RECs) your system makes. For a home system of 10 kW or less in program year 2026-27 the REC price is $70.37 in Group A (Ameren Illinois and MidAmerican areas) and $80.77 in Group B (ComEd area); for 10 to 25 kW it is $60.92 and $79.21. A REC is 1 MWh of solar power, and the payment is the REC price times the RECs the system is expected to make over its 15 or 20 year contract. For contracts approved on or after June 1, 2026, 50% is paid at energization and the rest over six years.
facts.amount: REC price $70.37 or $80.77 for 0 to 10 kW
facts.eligibility: Approved Vendor submits the application for you; project up to 25 kW is Small Distributed Generation
facts.dates: Program year 2026-27 began June 1, 2026
facts.notes: REC prices read 2026-10-06 from the Final 2026-27 REC Prices PDF on illinoisshines.com. Group A and B territories read from the Illinois Shines Program Guidebook 2025-26 (the 2026-27 guidebook was not read). We cannot say what the payment is in dollars for a house without the system's expected output.

facts.claim: A $20 per REC adder for customer-owned Small DG projects in 2026-27 that will not receive the federal investment tax credit or residential clean energy credit; applies to applications batched and paid on or after June 1, 2026.

facts.dates: 2026-27 program year
facts.notes: Read 2026-10-06 on the Illinois Shines page and the REC prices PDF.
